content.text:
Ready in kanban.
Tell me what to ship — I open lanes, spawn implementers and reviewers, and merge on APPROVE. Nothing starts until you ask.

message.content: What do you need from me to take the two readiness issues?

content.text: Just the word. One lane per issue — a worktree, an implementer, and a fresh reviewer every round. I merge on APPROVE, keep the task cards current, and come back here when something needs your decision.
